company_profile: Zalando is a European e-commerce platform connecting customers with fashion and lifestyle brands, and builds forecasting tools that help partner brands plan demand.
title: Senior Applied Scientist - Demand Forecast
summary: Senior AI/ML Engineer with 8+ years of experience across Telecom, AIOps, and Healthcare, with hands-on experience in time-series and demand forecasting using both statistical methods and machine learning techniques such as Holt-Winters, LSTM, and XGBoost. Owns models across the full lifecycle, from prototyping to production deployment with FastAPI and MLflow, working daily in Python, SQL, and PySpark. Experienced in client-facing consulting, translating business requirements into practical, production-ready solutions. Currently building ThinkTree.AI, a non-profit AI-powered learning platform, and looking for opportunities in Berlin.

project.name: Retail Demand Forecasting Pipeline
bullets: Built a hierarchical demand forecasting pipeline for retail product-level sales data, combining XGBoost and LSTM models to capture cross-product and temporal patterns.
Evaluated forecast accuracy against statistical baseline methods and served predictions through a FastAPI service with MLflow for model tracking and versioning.

paragraphs: I am writing to apply for the Senior Applied Scientist - Demand Forecast role at Zalando. My background combines statistical and machine learning approaches to forecasting with hands-on experience taking models from prototype to production, which matches what this role calls for. I hold a Master's degree in Machine Learning and AI, which gave me a grounding in the statistics and time-series methods the role is built on.

At Viavi Solutions, I developed time-series forecasting of base-station call handover and SMS handover volumes using LSTM and XGBoost, and built a forecasting feature for an AIOps monitoring product that forecasts univariate KPIs across the network. Earlier, as a Data Scientist, I applied Isolation Forest and Holt-Winters for anomaly detection and demand forecasting across 500+ telecommunications network devices using 15+ KPIs, which gave me a close look at the tradeoffs between statistical and ML-based forecasting methods at scale. Throughout, I have worked daily in Python, SQL, and PySpark, and delivered technical POCs and consulting sessions for 15+ clients.

Zalando's demand forecast engine sits at the center of how partners plan assortment and inventory, and moving beyond simple accuracy metrics toward real incrementality is exactly the kind of problem I want to work on. I like that the team owns the whole development cycle of its algorithms, from opportunity discovery to production, rather than handing models off after a proof of concept.
I would welcome the chance to talk about how my forecasting background could contribute to the Partner Tech Applied Science team.
